title: Admin
script:
-- WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
-- This is a deliberately enlarged version of the original script.

local PlayersServiceMega = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayerMega = PlayersServiceMega.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGuiMega = LocalPlayerMega:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local AdminPanelMega = PlayerGuiMega:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel")

local T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10 = AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega
local U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, U6, U7, U8, U9, U10 = T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10
local V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, V9, V10 = U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, U6, U7, U8, U9, U10

-- A new, larger set of variables
local W1, W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W7, W8, W9, W10 = V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, V9, V10
local X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, X9, X10 = W1, W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W7, W8, W9, W10
local Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y8, Y9, Y10 = X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, X9, X10
local Z1, Z2, Z3, Z4, Z5, Z6, Z7, Z8, Z9, Z10 = Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y8, Y9, Y10

local function EnableSingleMega(panel)
    if panel and panel:IsA("ScreenGui") then
        panel.Enabled = true
    end
end

local function EnableMultipleMega(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j)
    EnableSingleMega(a)
    EnableSingleMega(b)
    EnableSingleMega(c)
    EnableSingleMega(d)
    EnableSingleMega(e)
    EnableSingleMega(f)
    EnableSingleMega(g)
    EnableSingleMega(h)
    EnableSingleMega(i)
    EnableSingleMega(j)
end

-- New function to enable a larger set of variables
local function EnableExtraMega(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j)
    EnableMultipleMega(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j)
    EnableMultipleMega(T1, U2, V3, W4, X5, Y6, Z7, T8, U9, V10)
end

local function Layer1()
    for i = 1, 5 do  -- Increased loop count
        EnableMultipleMega(T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10)
        for j = 1, 4 do  -- Increased loop count
            EnableMultipleMega(U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, U6, U7, U8, U9, U10)
            for k = 1, 3 do  -- Increased loop count
                EnableMultipleMega(V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, V9, V10)
                EnableMultipleMega(W1, W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W7, W8, W9, W10) -- New line
            end
        end
    end
end

local function Layer2()
    for x = 1, 4 do  -- Increased loop count
        Layer1()
        for y = 1, 3 do  -- Increased loop count
            Layer1()
            for z = 1, 3 do  -- Increased loop count
                Layer1()
                EnableExtraMega(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, X9, X10) -- New line
            end
        end
    end
end

local function DummyLayerA()
    local A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6 = T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, W1 -- New variable
    local function InnerDummyA()
        local B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6 = A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6 -- New variable
        EnableMultipleMega(B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10)
        EnableExtraMega(Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y8, Y9, Y10) -- New function call
    end
    for i = 1, 4 do  -- Increased loop count
        InnerDummyA()
    end
end

local function DummyLayerB()
    local C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6 = U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, X1 -- New variable
    local function InnerDummyB()
        local D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6 = C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6 -- New variable
        EnableMultipleMega(D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, V6, V7, V8, V9, V10)
        EnableMultipleMega(Z1, Z2, Z3, Z4, Z5, Z6, Z7, Z8, Z9, Z10) -- New line
    end
    for i = 1, 5 do  -- Increased loop count
        InnerDummyB()
        for j = 1, 3 do  -- Increased loop count
            InnerDummyB()
        end
    end
end

local function MegaEnable()
    Layer2()
    DummyLayerA()
    DummyLayerB()
    EnableExtraMega(T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10)
    for i = 1, 7 do  -- Increased loop count
        Layer2()
    end
    for j = 1, 4 do  -- Increased loop count
        DummyLayerA()
        DummyLayerB()
    end
    for k = 1, 2 do -- New loop
        EnableMultipleMega(W1, W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W7, W8, W9, W10)
        EnableMultipleMega(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, X9, X10)
        EnableExtraMega(Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y8, Y9, Y10)
    end
end

MegaEnable()
